senses.gloss: (= הָא תָּם, v. תָּם II) there; in that case; opp. הָכָא q. v.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:6:3">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>רבנן דה׳</he> the Babylonian teachers.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5a:5">Snh. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>מה׳ לה׳</he> from Palestine for Palestine.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5b:13">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>שאני ה׳</he> there, in the case just cited, it is different; a. v. fr.
